review_evidence: README states that the project ports and extends formal verification of zkSNARK protocols, including BabySNARK, Groth16 and planned NOVA knowledge soundness.
A complete scan of all 17 Lean files found 244 declaration-style lines and 122 theorem/lemma/axiom/example-style declarations.

ZkSNARK/BabyZkSNARK/KnowledgeSoundness.lean formalizes the SSP, CRS/adversary polynomials and many supporting lemmas; the GeneralLemmas and Groth16 modules contain further reusable polynomial and knowledge-soundness proof material.
summary: Reviewed ZKSnark.lean and retain its explicit zkSNARK definitions and substantial knowledge-soundness theorem development.
